titles.title: Pink and Green Mountains II
Pink and Green Mountains No. II

description: Bands of color span the width of this abstract, landscape-like composition. A blue sliver with rounded white shapes could represent a sky. Below this, a pink band spreads horizontally along the composition, then a wide blue stripe. At the bottom of the composition, blue, green, and pale pink curved shapes that could denote distant hills.
title: Pink and Green Mountains No. II
